name: Edward McGuire
bioAdditions: The first-year state death index (1907) lists "McGuire, Edward; 38426; Plymouth; April 4" (S1). This fits the FamilySearch "April 1907, buried Plymouth" and gives an exact date and a certificate number. The certificate should state his age, birthplace in Ireland and parents, which would test the speculative Dublin baptism (Owen McGuire & Anne Clusky). His son James's birthplace was given in 1927 as Danville (S3), the post office of the 1870 household (S2). FamilySearch identifies further children: Edward (b. c1856), Mary (3 Nov 1858-4 Jun 1942, Mrs. Michael E. Riley of Plymouth), Cecilia Marcella (1864-1918, who married Murdock Dunn at Plymouth in 1887 and emigrated to Vancouver Island, British Columbia) and Timothy (c1865, dead by 1880) (S4).

relationships.evidence: Mary McGuire Riley: in Edward's 1870 household (age 12); her daughter's marriage record names her as Mary McGuire
Cecilia: "Mesilla" 5 in the 1870 household; married at Plymouth 1887 as Scylia McGuire

confidenceRecommendation.justification: The Danville birthplace in the 1927 licence strengthens the James link; the 1907 certificate (#38426) would confirm.
